parameters.Title: Close notes?
parameters.Effect: Every instance stops serving notes and its writer releases the dataset. Reads and writes answer 404 until it is opened again. Nothing is deleted.
parameters.Note:
The declaration will drift from Git

This changes the dataset's declaration on the server. Your declaration files in Git still say otherwise, so the next varve apply, including one run by CI, will undo it unless you change them too. varve apply --plan shows the difference.
